name: Light Pull
description: A framework-free Web Component that hangs a simulated cord you can take hold of anywhere, pull to work a switch, and set swinging — every joint carrying its own momentum rather than playing a rehearsed swing.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A cord hanging in a dark room: pull it far enough and the light comes on.

variants.name: Physics
variants.description: Three lengths taking the same shove, each swinging at the rate its length gives it.

variants.name: Switching
variants.description: One cord wired to two different things, and the event that is all it actually does.

variants.name: Sizes
variants.description: A very short cord, a very long one, a heavy chain, and a fine string.

variants.name: States
variants.description: On to begin with, worked from the keyboard, and what reduced motion leaves.
